class.name: SteamScreenshot
class.brief_description: A confirmed saved Steam screenshot and its annotation status.
class.description: The native handle stays internal. This snapshot describes metadata submissions observed by this scope. An ordinary screenshot or another scope's save has no local annotation requests.

members.member: Read-only [enum Error] codes for failed annotation requests, in location, user, and Workshop item order. Steam's rejection maps to [constant FAILED]. A missing native action maps to [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE]. A saved image stays available even when metadata fails.
Whether Steam accepted every annotation requested by this scope. Ordinary screenshots and saves from other scopes have no local annotations to reject.
